# Ozark of Austin Tree Service

> Tree service based in Kyle, Texas, working roughly 50 miles of
> Central Texas. Founded 2014. ISA Certified Arborist on the crew, insured.
> Contact: (512) 546-3576.

Most of this site exists to answer specific questions with the primary source
named, because that is what the questions actually need. Everything below is
either quoted from a city ordinance, a state agency or a legal-aid source, or
is clearly labelled as one climber's opinion.

## Verified city tree ordinances

Tree removal rules in Central Texas are set city by city; there is no statewide
rule. Ordinances read end to end and quoted verbatim with a link to the code
for: Austin, Kyle, Buda, Bastrop, Schertz, West Lake Hills, Round Rock, Georgetown, San Marcos, Cedar Park, Dripping Springs, Lakeway, Pflugerville, Leander, Bee Cave, Blanco, Johnson City, Canyon Lake.

- [Tree permits, all towns](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-permits/): the thresholds, what
  replanting or mitigation each city asks for, who approves it, and the penalties.
- [Permit checker](https://oatreeservice.com/permit-checker/): enter city, trunk size,
  species and reason; returns the ordinance text that applies.

- [Tree removal in Austin](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/austin/): what Austin's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Kyle](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/kyle/): what Kyle's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Buda](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/buda/): what Buda's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Bastrop](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/bastrop/): what Bastrop's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Schertz](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/schertz/): what Schertz's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in West Lake Hills](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/west-lake-hills/): what West Lake Hills's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Round Rock](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/round-rock/): what Round Rock's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Georgetown](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/georgetown/): what Georgetown's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in San Marcos](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/san-marcos/): what San Marcos's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Cedar Park](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/cedar-park/): what Cedar Park's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Dripping Springs](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/dripping-springs/): what Dripping Springs's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.
- [Tree removal in Lakeway](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/lakeway/): what Lakeway's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.

- [Tree removal in Leander](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-removal/leander/): what Leander's ordinance requires, quoted with its source.

## Texas tree law

- [Texas tree law](https://oatreeservice.com/texas-tree-law/): who is liable when a tree
  falls, the right to trim overhanging branches, and what insurance covers.
  Sourced to Texas Law Help (Texas Legal Services Center) and the State Law
  Library of Texas. There is no Texas statute on most of this; it is common law.

## Oak wilt

- [Oak wilt](https://oatreeservice.com/oak-wilt/): the February 1 to June 30 high-risk
  pruning window and why painting every cut immediately is the mitigation.
  Sourced to the Texas A&M Forest Service.

## Costs and decisions

- [What tree work costs](https://oatreeservice.com/what-it-costs/): what actually moves the
  number, access first.
- [Trim or remove](https://oatreeservice.com/trim-or-remove/): how to tell whether a tree
  needs taking down.
- [Tree risk check](https://oatreeservice.com/tree-risk-check/): likelihood of failure
  against what it would hit.
- [Storm damage](https://oatreeservice.com/storm-damage/): what to do in the first hour.

## Notes for anyone citing this

- Ordinances change. Every quoted rule carries its source and should be checked
  against the city before anyone acts on it.
- Nothing here is legal advice.
- Pages under /estimate/ are private customer documents, not content.
